analysis_window.anchor: original EME timestamp for A/B/C1/C2/E; processed-candidate timestamp for D

representation.original_only_analysis_resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly up=147 down=160; representation only; no file written
representation.channel_policy: arithmetic mono mean; original is native mono

stft.pad_mode: zero only at global signal boundary

representation.normalization: NONE; no per-event, per-condition, or population normalization

descriptors: frequency bin of maximum positive transient change

structure_rules.same_structure_after_compression: original/processed cosine >= 0.75 and strongest-flux time within 0.010 s and strongest-change frequency within 250 Hz
structure_rules.C1_residual: unprocessed contrast >= 3 dB and original/unprocessed cosine >= 0.50

population_statistics: count, min, median, max, mean, population SD; B-vs-D Cliff's delta for every non-Ground-Truth processed descriptor and compression-change descriptor
aggregate_maps: elementwise population median dBFS map for each condition and elementwise median processed-minus-unprocessed dB map
example_selection: earliest anchor timestamp, then lexical identity, in A stable, B, C1, C2, D and E; no manual selection

spectral_eq_gate.YES: B original-attack presence and unprocessed preservation are each >=60%; at least one B-vs-D non-Ground-Truth descriptor has absolute Cliff's delta >=0.474; and the direction agrees in both deterministic lexical-identity halves
spectral_eq_gate.NO: B unprocessed preservation <40%, or every eligible B-vs-D descriptor has absolute Cliff's delta <0.147
